title: Finite Frobenius exchanges and their chosen compact-support inverse
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $p,a,q,k_0,k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, a uniformizer $\varpi$ and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$, $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a separated finite-type morphism between finite-type $k_0$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Write $f:X\to Y$ for its base change to $k$, and $g_X,g_Y$ for the geometric-Frobenius scheme automorphisms [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. Work in the unbounded derived categories of $A_n$-module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with $Lf^*$, $Rf_*$ and $j_!$ of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-direct-image, def-weil-extension-by-zero].

Supply a compactification $c_0=(j_0,p_0)$ of $f_0$ over $k_0$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and write $c=(j,p)$ for its base change. Thus $j$ is open, $p$ is proper, $f=pj$, and $Rf_!^c=Rp_*j_!$ is the chosen ambient functor [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Let $\operatorname{FrEx}_{f,*}$ be precisely the unit--pullback-compositor--counit mate of [def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange], item 1, and let $b: Lg_{\overline X}^*j_!\to j_!Lg_X^*$ be the canonical open-square exchange in its item 2. For every $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A_n)$ the two specified arrows
$$\operatorname{FrEx}_{f,*}(K):Lg_Y^*Rf_*K\longrightarrow Rf_*Lg_X^*K,$$
$$\operatorname{FrEx}_{f,!}^c(K)=Rp_*(b_K)\circ\operatorname{FrEx}_{p,*}(j_!K):Lg_Y^*Rf_!^cK\longrightarrow Rf_!^cLg_X^*K$$
are isomorphisms, natural in $K$, in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_n)$. In particular the inverse of the second is
$$\operatorname{FrEx}_{p,*}(j_!K)^{-1}\circ Rp_*(b_K^{-1}).$$
On the witnessed etale-origin domain, meaning $K\cong\nu_X^*L$ for $L\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A_n)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], let $d$ be another compactification of $f$ and let $C_{d,c}:Rf_!^d\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_!^c$ be the specified comparison [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed]. The transported compact exchange
$$C_{d,c}(Lg_X^*K)^{-1}\circ\operatorname{FrEx}_{f,!}^c(K)\circ Lg_Y^*C_{d,c}(K)$$
is invertible, with inverse $Lg_Y^*C_{d,c}(K)^{-1}\circ\operatorname{FrEx}_{f,!}^c(K)^{-1}\circ C_{d,c}(Lg_X^*K)$. No independence of the exchange from $c$ is asserted. The horizontal Frobenii are used as scheme isomorphisms, without an assumption that they are $k$-linear. No properness of $f$ or separatedness of $X_0,Y_0$ over $k_0$ is required.

proof.text: The geometric Frobenius of each of X0, Y0 and the retained middle model is the scheme automorphism of def-weil-frobenius-detailed. In intrinsic finite-coefficient coordinates form H = pullback along the inverse scheme map. The composition and identity natural isomorphisms of lem-trf-open-square-exchange, together with the two scheme inverse equations, give F H isomorphic to the identity and H F isomorphic to the identity. Equivalence.mk gives that each intrinsic derived pullback is an equivalence. This works for arbitrary finite coefficients and requires neither a stalk-prime-unit argument nor k-linearity.

Apply lem-weil-mate-iso-along-equivalences to the canonical intrinsic derived adjunctions and the composition/commutativity pullback isomorphism in the actual finiteExchange definition. The horizontal equivalences from step 1 give its hypotheses. The two coordinate changes openSquareDerivedPullbackModel are natural isomorphisms, so whiskering and composition give invertibility of finiteTensorExchange. Specialize to f0 and the retained proper part using the commutativity of lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian. These are precisely the specified direct finite Frobenius transformations of def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange; use asIso for their natural isomorphisms.

Use the canonical constantOpenSquareExchange b of lem-trf-open-square-exchange on the very Cartesian square supplied in frobeniusFiniteOpenExchange by lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian. Whisker the proper natural isomorphism on the left by the intrinsic open functor J, then compose with b whiskered on the right by the proper image P. Its hom is definitionally frobeniusCompactFinite. The inverse of this composite is definitionally P.map(b.inv at K) followed by the proper inverse at J K, proving the requested formula without choosing any new exchange.

The existing definitions retain the pulledCompactOrigin witness and the specified frobeniusFiniteComparison C. No new witness or comparison is chosen. In arbitrary categories the composite F.mapIso(a), b, c.symm has forward map F.map(a.hom) followed by b.hom and c.inv, and inverse c.hom followed by b.inv and F.map(a.inv); their products cancel. Evaluate C on O and its pulled witness, use b = compactIso.app O.K, and substitute the equality compactIso.hom = frobeniusCompactFinite in the cancellation laws. Give the transported isomorphism exactly the specified forward and reverse arrows as fields. This proves both formulas without any further origin or coherence theorem.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q103-9b801d11a (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read the item in full; there are no new nodes. The statement, stmt_deps and blueprint are byte-identical to the Q78-created node, and the 4 inherited searches are kept with 5 added. No repair note applies. Step 1: lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian, applied to f0 and p0, gives the automorphisms g_X, g_Y and g_Xbar. With ell != p, lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback-equivalence makes their pullbacks equivalences on unbounded D(-_proet,A_{E,n}). Step 2: I checked the typing of lem-weil-mate-iso-along-equivalences (L=L'=Lf^*, G=Lg_Y^*, G'=Lg_X^*). Its alpha is exactly the unit-theta-counit formula of def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange used in item 1 of def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange, theta is an isomorphism by definition, and the argument is the same for p. Step 3: lem-trf-frobenius-open-square (m=1) gives the Cartesian open square, and lem-trf-open-square-exchange gives the natural isomorphism b. Item 2 of the definition is Rp_*(b) after FrEx_{p,*} on all of D(X_proet), since Rf_!^c is defined on the ambient category, so the inverse formula is correct. Step 4: the finite Lg^* is termwise inverse image, and lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback gives an etale-origin witness for Lg_X^*K in D^+. prop-compactification-coherence-detailed (f separated finite type between finite-type schemes, ell invertible) supplies C_{d,c} at K and at Lg_X^*K, and the conjugated inverse is correct. The step makes no claim that the construction is independent of c. Source: Deligne Weil II (1.1.7) and (1.1.10)-(1.1.14), pp. 150-153, read; it motivates the transport, and the proof is correctly marked agent-written. No SGA. Edge cases checked: K=0, empty X0, f=id, j=id, d=c, unbounded K, and non-separated X0/Y0. Duplicate search over the 73 FrEx/Frobenius-exchange nodes (coef-frobenius-exchange-equivalence, pod compact-support exchange, pbc exchange-restriction, trf compact-power-exchange, native adic mates, the system-exchange-inverse sibling) found none at the finite ambient level. The trf and comparison-pullback citations are already in the stmt closure of def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange, so they add nothing new to the closure. Tool uses accepted. prop-compactification-coherence is on route anyway (sk-def-sf-operations).
